body.heading: Build the towers
paragraphs: Stand two stacks of books with a gap between them, like two towers by a river.
Lay one flat book across the top. That is your bridge.

body.heading: Test the bridge
paragraphs: Drive your car across slowly. Did it wobble? Engineers fix wobbles.
Try a longer gap or a second layer. Every test teaches you something, even the collapses.

takeaway: Engineers test their bridges before anyone drives across.
materials: A ruler or stick for measuring
safetyNotes: An adult checks the bridge is low and steady before the car drives over.
